speaker: 旁白
text: 门外刚下过一阵急雨。

speaker: 旁白
text: 一名二十四五岁的年轻女性收起折叠伞，踩着高跟鞋走到星见医院的前台。她留着整齐的短发，身着剪裁贴身的深蓝色职业西装套裙，胸前别着医疗器械公司的访客牌。

speaker: 前台接待员
text: 「您好，请问有预约吗？」

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「霜月美佳，下午两点半。跟贵院采购窗口联系过，今天来送新型手术器械的产品目录。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 前台接待员低头核对登记簿。

speaker: 前台接待员
text: 「啊，有的。请稍等，我帮您联系负责接洽的外科医生。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳保持着得体的职业微笑，目光却越过前台，状似不经意地扫向内部临床走廊。

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「听说贵院最近刚从海外请来一位技术很全面的坂口医生，整个外科的手术量一下子扩充了不少。我们公司也是听到风声，才赶紧带最新一批器械目录过来拜访。」

speaker: 前台接待员
text: 「坂口医生最近确实很忙呢。说起来，你们公司派女性代表过来真是太巧了，我们医院有个奇怪的惯例，平时都不安排男性推销员进临床区。」

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「来之前听同行提过一句，所以这次专门由我负责跟进。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 她答得十分自然，只是说话间仍在留意走廊来往的医护人员。

speaker: 旁白
text: 不远处的走廊尽头，神宮寺成美正拿着一份病历夹走过。

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳的视线在触及成美脸庞与胸前姓名牌的一瞬间，目光微不可察地停滞了一秒，随即迅速移开视线，低头整理手里的文件夹。

speaker: 旁白
text: 成美脚步未停，神色如常地转进外科护士站。

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋正在核对下午的耗材单，见成美进来，轻声抬头。

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「成美医生？」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「前台刚登记的那位女推销员，之前和我们医院有过业务往来吗？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋看了一眼内部流转单：

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「没有，登记表上写着是第一次来拜访，借着坂口医生入职、外科扩充业务的机会，来送新型妇科与盆腔手术器械目录的。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 成美指尖在病历夹边缘轻轻停住。

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「第一次来拜访……可刚才在走廊迎面遇上的时候，她看见我的第一反应，不太像是在看一个素昧平生的医生。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋神色微凛：

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「……会不会只是碰巧认识您的名字？」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「也许只是我多心了。单凭一个眼神，还说明不了什么。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 她合上病历夹，声音平静而谨慎。

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「不过谨慎起见，先别惊动坂口医生。三号备用手术室今天下午没有排台，设备也刚检查完毕。你待会儿去前台接她的时候，先别自报姓名，以『去手术区实地核对器械盘规格』为由，直接把她领到三号手术室旁边的术前准备室。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋看了成美一眼，立刻领会了她的用意。

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「明白了。我把胸牌收一下，这就去领她过来。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳将印着商标的产品目录在桌面一页页摊开，讲解的语速干脆利落。

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「这套盆腔拉钩和无损伤分离钳采用的是改良弧度设计，在深部狭小术野里也能保持良好的暴露角度，而且钳口齿槽经过特殊钝化处理，能最大程度减少对卵巢皮质和周围血管的夹持损伤。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美翻看着参数页，神色平静：

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「规格参数和适应证背得很熟，看来霜月小姐确实是常年跑妇外科器械线的专业销售。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳露出几分自得的微笑：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「毕竟我手里对接的都是几家大医院的重点科室，业务如果不熟，可进不了主刀医生的门。」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「不过，这套器械的长期临床随访数据，目录里好像没有附？」

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「那一部分数据还在整理，稍后我可以让公司发到贵院的采购邮箱。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 她一边收起展示图表，一边看似随意地话锋一转：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「说起来，我在拜访之前做功课的时候，就觉得神宮寺医生的名字很眼熟。您来星见医院之前，是不是在另一家规模很大的综合医院任职？」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「我的医生履历向来公开，算不上什么秘密。」

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「那家医院的科研平台在业内可是出了名的。您怎么会突然离开那里，转到这么一家小医院来呢？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 成美没有立刻回答，只是静静地看着她把话题引向人事变动。

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳继续整理着文件夹，状似无意地补上一句：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「而且我听说，那家医院当时还有年轻护士也差不多在同一时间离职了。像刚才去前台带我进来的那位七瀬护士，动作那么熟练，应该也是那时候跟着您一起过来的老搭档吧？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 敲门声恰在此时响起。

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋端着托盘走进来，随手将准备室通往外侧走廊的房门轻轻合上。

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「打扰了。成美医生，您要的茶。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 她把茶杯放到桌上，却没有转身离开，而是停在门边，目光平静地落在霜月美佳脸上。

speaker: 旁白
text: 刚才在门外听见最后一句话的恋，心里已然雪亮——她去前台接人的时候特意套着没有胸牌的工作罩衫，一路上只字未提自己的名字，更没有聊过半句器械规格之外的话；可眼前这个女人不仅一口叫出了「七瀬护士」，甚至连她和成美来自同一家旧医院的事都一清二楚。

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美端起茶杯，却没有喝，语气淡淡地开口：

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「正好，七瀬护士，霜月小姐刚才还在关心我们两个人以前的履历呢。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳笑道：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「只是做销售的职业习惯，顺口问问罢了。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋站在门边，声音虽然轻柔，却字字清晰：

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「如果是做器械销售的职业习惯，刚才我从一楼领您进手术区这一路，您本该问我医院现有的器械托盘尺寸和消毒流程才对。可您从进门起，看的就不是器械柜，而是走廊墙上的值班表。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳脸上的笑意微微一僵：

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美放下茶杯，目光直视着她的眼睛：

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「我也很想请教一下，霜月小姐。刚才在前台，接待员并没有向你介绍护理部的名单；七瀬护士去接你的时候，既没有戴胸牌，也没有自报家门——你是怎么在没人介绍的情况下，一口叫出她姓『七瀬』的？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳眼神闪了一下，勉强笑道：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「我……我来之前向同行打听过贵院的医护配置……」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「星见医院对外公开的只有主治医生的简介，护理人员的排班与履历从来不对外公布。更何况，就连院内的同事，也很少有人知道她以前和我在同一家医院共事过。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 成美伸手将桌上那本精美的器械产品目录合上，连同对方领口那枚眼熟的旧展会订制胸针一并收入眼底。

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「器械介绍就到此为止吧。接下来的问题，我们聊点目录之外的。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 准备室里的空气骤然冷了下来。

speaker: 旁白
text: 被当场戳穿漏洞的霜月美佳迅速抓起桌上的公文包，猛地站起身。

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「既然神宮寺医生对产品不感兴趣，那一定是有什么误会，我就不打扰了。告辞。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋安静地站在门前，一步也没有让。

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「霜月小姐，请先回答成美医生的问题。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳脸色铁青：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「你们想干什么？你们无权拦我！」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「你说得对。所以只要你老老实实告诉我们，是谁派你拿着名单来星见医院核实我们两个人的，我现在就不再浪费你的时间。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳咬紧牙关：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「没有谁！我只是——」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「比良坂竜二？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 这五个字落在安静的准备室里，轻得几乎没有声音。

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳的瞳孔却在瞬间剧烈收缩，原本强撑出来的镇定彻底碎裂，连握着公文包的手指都抖了一下。

speaker: 旁白
text: 站在门边的七瀬恋缓缓垂下眼帘。

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「看来没猜错。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳厉声喝道：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「让开！别以为你们躲到这种地方就能装作什么都没发生过——！」

speaker: 旁白
text: 她猛地转身冲向房门，伸手去拧门把。

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「霜月小姐，等一下——」

speaker: 旁白
text: 短促的挣扎声打断了她的话。

speaker: 旁白
text: 恋敏捷地侧身扣住霜月美佳的手腕，与此同时，成美已经取出预先备好的注射器，果断刺入她的上臂。

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳惊恐地睁大眼睛，只觉得胳膊一阵刺痛，想要高声呼救，声音却迅速失去了力气。

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「你们……居然敢在医院里……」

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美扶住她顺着门板下滑的身体。

speaker: 旁白
text: 她没有说完最后一个字，便彻底失去了意识。

speaker: 旁白
text: 房间里安静下来。

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋望着地上的霜月美佳，抬头看向成美。

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「成美医生，真的要继续吗？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美看了她一眼，声音冷静而克制。

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「现在停下，比良坂明天就会派第三个人来。只有让她彻底不敢再掺和这件事，我们才能争取到时间。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋缓缓点头。

speaker: 旁白
text: 她脸上平常温柔的笑容已经完全消失。

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳醒来时，首先看见的是准备室惨白的天花板。

speaker: 旁白
text: 她躺在一张移动病床上，外套、西装裙和高跟鞋已不见踪影，身上换成了单薄的病号服，头发被术前帽严严实实地收拢起来。

speaker: 旁白
text: 手腕旁连接着心电与血压监测设备。

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋穿着一身绿色刷手服站在床边，检查着仪器显示的数据。

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「醒了。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳猛地挣扎着想要坐起来，却被床侧的约束带扣住。

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「你们究竟想干什么？！快放开我，我要报警！」

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美拿着一份文件夹走到她面前。

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「先看看这个。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 纸张顶端清晰地印着：

speaker: 旁白
text: 《诊断性开腹探查术同意书》

speaker: 旁白
text: 患者姓名栏，写着「霜月美佳」。

speaker: 旁白
text: 签名栏里，也有一笔几乎与她本人字迹完全相同的签名。

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳脸色煞白：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「这不是我签的！」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「我知道。」

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「那是伪造的！你们这是犯罪！」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「当然是伪造的。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 她承认得如此平静，反而让霜月美佳一瞬间忘记了下一句该怎么骂。

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「现在我再问一次。比良坂竜二让你来这里做什么？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳死死咬着嘴唇：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「我什么都不知道！」

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美轻轻合上文件夹。

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「那我们只好换个地方谈了。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳声音发颤：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「……换去哪里？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 内侧通道另一头，三号备用手术室的大门缓缓打开。

speaker: 旁白
text: 移动病床停在三号备用手术室的手术台旁。

speaker: 旁白
text: 整间手术室里只有神宮寺成美与七瀬恋两人。

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳在刺目的无影灯光下看见那张狭长的手术台，终于明白先前那份同意书不是简单的吓唬。

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「不……不行！我没病！我根本不需要做什么手术！」

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋戴着外科口罩，只穿了一身绿色刷手服站在台边，声音仍旧很轻，却没有给她任何保证。

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「我听见了。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 成美与恋两人将霜月美佳移上手术台，将双腕与双腿的固定带逐一扣合。霜月美佳惊恐地看见器械台上整齐排列的金属器械，听见恋拆开准备包时布料、金属和包装材料发出的细微声响。

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳一遍遍哭喊着自己没有签过同意书。

speaker: 旁白
text: 然而恋手里的术前准备并未因此停止。

speaker: 旁白
text: 腹部备皮、留置导尿和碘伏消毒等步骤依次在恋熟练而沉默的操作下完成；当绿色的无菌洞巾铺满全身并固定好时，暴露在无影灯强光下的只剩下预定的腹部术野。

speaker: 旁白
text: 这些步骤在真正的手术中本来有各自的医疗目的；现在它们被用来制造一种令人绝望的假象。

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳眼泪滑落进手术帽边缘，冲着台边的恋哭喊道：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「求你们……别开刀！我说了我不是患者！七瀬护士，你看起来明明不是这种人……快让她停下来啊！」

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美此时已经换好完整的无菌手术衣、戴好无菌手套，缓步走到主刀位旁。

speaker: 旁白
text: 外科口罩遮住了她的下半张脸，露出的双眼冷静得几乎没有情绪。

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「你不是患者。这一点我比任何人都清楚。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳浑身发抖：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「那为什么……？！」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「因为你从进门开始，就把这里当成了另一个人的地盘。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 她朝对面的恋伸出手。

speaker: 旁白
text: 一把手术刀被放进她戴着无菌手套的掌心里。

speaker: 旁白
text: 金属没有发出任何特别的声音，躺着无法动弹的霜月美佳却像听见了什么极其可怕的东西。

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美没有举起刀刃，而是把冰凉的刀背隔着尚未划开的腹部术野轻轻贴了上去。

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「最后一次。是谁派你来的？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳彻底崩溃，尖叫声猛地冲口而出：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「比良坂！是比良坂医生！全都是他的主意！」

speaker: 旁白
text: 成美的手停在原处没有动。

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳涕泪横流地大喊：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「他听说你们可能在星见医院，让我借着送器械目录的机会来确认！他要你们现在的名字、职务、住址，还有你们到底跟城宮院长提过多少过去的事！」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「他为什么找你？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳喘息着哭道：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「因为我在替他做妇科器械销售！我手里的大医院合同全捏在他那边，我欠他人情，私下也跟他有过关系……我拿了他的钱，可他也警告过我，只要我不肯替他跑这一趟，他就让所有合作医院彻底封杀我！」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「所以你就来了。」

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「是！我以为只是来核实一眼人、问几句话而已！我没有想害你们！」

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋一直站在器械台旁，手轻轻贴在刷手服胸前口袋的位置，藏在里面的微型录音笔正在工作。

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳断断续续地交代了联络方式、报酬和约定的报告期限。她说得太急太快，好几次不得不停下来大口喘气。

speaker: 旁白
text: 成美没有提刀，也没有收刀，像是在等待一份报告翻到最后一页。

speaker: 旁白
text: 终于，七瀬恋抬起头。

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「成美医生。她已经说了。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 手术室里安静下来。

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美看了恋一眼，随即收回手，把那把手术刀放回了器械台。

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「结束。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳怔怔地瞪着她：

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「不会有人切开你。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳一时说不出话。

speaker: 旁白
text: 过了许久，她才带着哭腔颤声问：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「你从一开始……就在演戏？」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「我从来没有打算下刀。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳崩溃地哭喊道：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「可是我躺在台上的时候怎么可能知道！」

speaker: 旁白
text: 这一次，成美没有回答，只是与恋一起动手替她松开固定带、撤去洞巾与导尿管。

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口隆司原本是来手术区尽头的器材室确认一份手术缝线的库存记录。

speaker: 旁白
text: 经过三号备用手术室外的内走廊时，他看见门口的指示灯反常地亮着，而今天下午的排班表上这里并没有安排任何病例。

speaker: 旁白
text: 隔着厚重的门板，他隐约听见里面传出了一个男人的名字。

speaker: 旁白
text: 比良坂竜二。

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口停下脚步。这个名字，他不久前在成美办公室的旧文献扉页上刚刚见过。

speaker: 旁白
text: 紧接着，是女人失控的哭喊声。

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口眉头微蹙，走近门边的观察窗死角向内看去——只见手术台上铺着洞巾，穿着无菌手术衣的成美正将一把未沾血迹的手术刀放回器械台，冷淡地说出那句「不会有人切开你……我从来没有打算下刀」；而站在旁边的恋只穿着一身绿色刷手服，正上前替台上的女人撤去铺

speaker: 旁白
text: 巾。

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口搭在门把边缘的手缓缓松开。

speaker: 旁白
text: 尽管眼前的场面明显超出了正常医疗的界限，但看见成美主动收刀、又听见她明确表示不会下刀后，坂口并没有推门进去兴师问罪。他很清楚，能让平时最守规矩的成美和恋在医院里做出这种违规举动，背后必定有极其棘手的隐情。

speaker: 旁白
text: 就在这时，走廊另一头传来了脚步声。一名值班护士端着托盘走过来，疑惑地看向亮着灯的三号手术室：

speaker: 值班护士
text: 「咦？坂口医生，三号备用手术室傍晚有临时手术吗？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口隆司不动声色地侧身挡在门前，平静地开口：

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「没有手术。刚才我让神宮寺医生和七瀬护士在里面帮我核对几件器械的摆放，顺手开了灯，马上就收拾好了。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 值班护士点了点头：

speaker: 值班护士
text: 「原来是这样，那我先去前面忙了。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 支走值班护士后，坂口最后看了一眼门内正在收拾器械的两人，没有出声打扰，悄然转身离开了走廊。

speaker: 旁白
text: 门内，刚摘下口罩的七瀬恋透过观察窗瞥见那道离开的白色背影，微微一怔：

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「成美医生……门外刚才好像是坂口医生。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美望向窗外空荡荡的走廊，神色微凛：

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「……先把她送去观察室。今天的事，我们做完善后就去向院长坦白。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 独立观察室里，霜月美佳已经换回了自己的衣服。

speaker: 旁白
text: 刚才一名未参与下午事件的普通门诊护士已按常规流程进来替她测量过血压与心率，确认她生命体征平稳，暂未发现明显急性异常后方才离开。

speaker: 旁白
text: 此时成美和恋站在门口，没有再靠近她。

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「录音我会妥善保管，不会交给比良坂。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳抬头，脸色变得更加难看：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「……你们还录了音？」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「那张伪造的同意书已经销毁了。你可以去报警，或者向院长投诉今天的事，我们不会否认。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳握紧手机，指节发白：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「然后呢？你们再把我的供述录音交出去？」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「我们不能替你决定后果。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳包里的手机震动了一下，屏幕上跳出一条催促汇报进展的短讯。

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳盯着屏幕，声音发涩：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「他问我有没有找到你们的时候，我要怎么回答？如果我说找到了，他一定会追问我为什么在医院待了这么久；如果我说了手术室的事，他只会怀疑我已经把他的事全都供出来了。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 她慢慢抬起头，看向门边的两人：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「他对背叛自己的人是什么手段，你们比我清楚吧？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美的眼睛冷下来：

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「我们知道。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳低头在手机上飞快地打字，删改了几次，终于按下了发送键——『已按约定接触星见医院。未发现目标二人在职的证据。建议不再投入人力。』

speaker: 旁白
text: 她把发送成功的屏幕亮给成美看了一眼，冷冷地开口：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「我已经告诉他你们不在这里了。不是因为我相信你们，我只是……不想把我自己搭进去。」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「我不会要求你感谢我们。」

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「也千万别。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋把她的随身公文包放在桌边：

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「车已经叫好在医院门口了。司机只知道要送一位离院的访客，要不要坐由你自己决定。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳拿起包走到门口，忽然停住脚步：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「你们究竟是什么人？」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「星见医院的医生和护士。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 霜月美佳望了她很久，冷笑了一声：

speaker: 霜月美佳
text: 「……今天我可一点都不想相信这句话。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 说完，她头也不回地离开了医院。

speaker: 旁白
text: 送走霜月美佳后，神宮寺成美与七瀬恋没有回休息室，而是直接敲开了院长办公室的门。

speaker: 旁白
text: 办公桌上放着那支录音笔，以及两人主动写好的情况说明。

speaker: 旁白
text: 城宮明日香听完经过，确认离院前已有独立医护核实过霜月美佳生命体征平稳后，轻轻吐出一口气，神色严肃地看向两人。

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 「你们两个没有瞒着我，在送走她之后第一时间主动来我这里坦白，这一点我记下了。」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「擅自动用备用手术室吓唬访客是我决定的，所有内部处分请由我承担，不要连累医院和恋。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋连忙开口：

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「院长，我是自愿配合成美医生的，要罚请把我也算上。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 城宮明日香摇了摇头，语气虽不严厉，却透着明确的底线：

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 「当初我顶着压力收留你们来星见，就是希望你们能摆脱过去的环境，堂堂正正地做医生和护士。哪怕今天你们从头到尾都没打算真下刀，把医院的手术室当成恐吓工具也是绝对越界的行为。这次的记录我会封存在内部档案里，但从今往后，星见的手术室绝不允许再发生第

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 二次类似的事，明白吗？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美郑重低头：

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「我明白，院长。绝不会有第二次。」

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「对不起，院长……」

speaker: 旁白
text: 明日香的神色缓和下来，手指轻轻点在情况说明的最后一段上：

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 「不过，你们刚才提到，傍晚坂口医生路过三号手术室门外，不仅听见了动静，还主动帮你们支走了路过的值班护士？」

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「是。他没有推门进来指责我们，但当时一定听见了『比良坂』的名字。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋轻声道：

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「而且霜月美佳今天下午在前台登记的时候，还特意拿坂口医生刚入职的事当借口。万一比良坂没有完全相信那份假报告，下次再派人来试探，很可能会落到坂口医生那边……」

speaker: 旁白
text: 城宮明日香思索片刻，抬头征询两人的意见：

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 「坂口医生既然在门外替你们解了围，又是你们现在最常配合的外科搭档，继续对他瞒着反而容易让他被动。明天早上我找他聊十分钟，在不谈你们旧院具体隐私的前提下，把比良坂派人调查的事给他透个底——你们同意吗？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美与七瀬恋对视一眼，同时点了点头。

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「如果是坂口医生的话，我同意。」

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「嗯，我也没问题。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 次日一早，坂口隆司应约来到院长办公室。

speaker: 旁白
text: 城宮明日香将一杯温茶推到他面前：

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 「早上好，坂口医生。赶在门诊开始前叫你过来，只耽误你十分钟。」

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「早上好，院长。是为了昨天傍晚三号备用手术室的事吧。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 城宮明日香微微一笑：

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 「果然瞒不过你。昨晚成美和恋把那个叫霜月美佳的推销员送走后，马上就来找我坦白领罚了。她们还特意跟我说，昨天傍晚多亏你在门外帮她们支走了路过的护士。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口隆司端起茶杯：

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「我只是看她们当时已经在收尾了，没必要让更多人撞见。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 城宮明日香看着他：

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 「发现自己信赖的医生和护士在备用手术室里做明显违规的事，坂口医生当时就没有想过直接推门进去叫停她们？」

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「我看见神宮寺医生主动收了刀，也听见她说不会下刀。既然人不会出事，我没必要冲进去把局面弄得更乱。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 城宮明日香轻轻叹了口气，点了点头：

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 「虽然她们昨天在手术室里的做法确实越了界，但你看见成美已经收刀，也听见她说自己本来就没打算切开患者，还替她们挡开了路过的人。她们心里一定很感激。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 城宮明日香收起笑意，认真地向坂口隆司说明了原委：

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 「在征得成美和恋同意的前提下，我今天找你来，是想正式给你透个底。成美和恋以前都在比良坂竜二掌控的医院工作过，后来与他彻底决裂。尤其是成美，她和比良坂之间有一笔非常复杂的旧账。具体发生过什么，我想还是应该由她自己告诉你。当年她们离开那里、在医

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 学界遭到比良坂打压的时候，是我把她们招进了星见。」

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「所以昨天那个霜月美佳，是比良坂派来查她们下落的调查者。」

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 「对。虽然霜月美佳昨晚为了自保，向比良坂发回了『未发现在职证据』的假报告，但比良坂那种人未必会轻易相信。加上昨天对方在前台特意提到你的名字，如果接下来比良坂换一种更隐蔽的方式继续试探星见，很可能会直接接触你的外科门诊。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口隆司颔首：

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「明白了。如果门诊或转诊里有异常，我会第一时间留意。」

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 「还有一件事——昨晚她们两个离开院长室的时候，其实一直很忐忑，担心你看见了昨天那一幕之后，会觉得她们是危险人物，不愿意再和她们搭档。」

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「昨天的方式我虽然不赞同，但我认识的神宮寺医生和七瀬护士，不只是在那间手术室里看到的样子。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 城宮明日香露出了然的微笑：

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 「真像你会说的话。听见你这么说，我就彻底放心了。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 墙上的挂钟正好走过十分钟，指向八点五十分。

speaker: 旁白
text: 城宮明日香站起身：

speaker: 城宮明日香
text: 「好啦，十分钟刚刚好。不用我替你传话——她们两个大概从刚才起就在外面的走廊上等着看你的脸色了。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口隆司起身道别，推开院长办公室的门走出去。

speaker: 旁白
text: 走廊拐角的阳光下，正准备分别前往门诊和病房的神宮寺成美与七瀬恋果然停在那里。

speaker: 旁白
text: 听见开门声，两人同时转过头来。平日里从容淡定的成美指尖微微收紧，恋更是有些局促地望着他。

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「坂、坂口医生……院长跟你说完了？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口隆司看了看两人略显紧绷的神色，像平时查房前一样自然地扬了扬手中的记录板。

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「说完了。离九点开诊还有十分钟，神宮寺医生，今天下午那台手术的术前评估单核对过了吗？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 神宮寺成美微微一怔，眼底那层紧绷的防备悄然融化，嘴角重新浮现出平日里那抹温婉而知性的笑意。

speaker: 神宮寺成美
text: 「已经核对好了，随时可以上台。」

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口隆司又转向一旁的七瀬恋：

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「七瀬护士，今天病房的晨间交接呢？」

speaker: 旁白
text: 七瀬恋眼睛一下子亮了起来，用力点了点头，露出明朗的笑容：

speaker: 七瀬恋
text: 「全部确认完毕！随时可以开始工作，坂口医生！」

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口隆司轻轻颔首：

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「那就走吧。」

speaker: Narrator
text: A brief downpour had just passed outside.

speaker: Narrator
text: A young woman in her mid-twenties folded her umbrella and approached Hoshimi Hospital's reception desk in high heels. Her short hair was neatly styled, and she wore a fitted navy business suit with a medical-device

speaker: Narrator
text: company visitor badge pinned to her chest.

speaker: Receptionist
text: “Good afternoon. Do you have an appointment?”

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “Mika Shimotsuki, two thirty. I contacted your purchasing office. I'm here to deliver our catalogue of new surgical instruments.”

speaker: Narrator
text: The receptionist looked down to check the register.

speaker: Receptionist
text: “Ah, yes. Please wait a moment while I contact the surgeon assigned to meet you.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika maintained a polished professional smile, but her gaze drifted past the desk toward the clinical corridor as if by chance.

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “I heard your hospital recently recruited Dr. Sakaguchi from overseas, an exceptionally versatile surgeon, and that your surgical volume has grown sharply. Once our company heard, we hurried over with our newest

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: instrument catalogue.”

speaker: Receptionist
text: “Dr. Sakaguchi certainly has been busy lately. It's lucky your company sent a woman. Our hospital has an unusual custom and normally doesn't let male sales representatives into the clinical area.”

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “A colleague mentioned that before I came, so I was assigned to this account.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Her reply was perfectly natural, though she continued watching the staff moving through the corridor as she spoke.

speaker: Narrator
text: At the far end of the hall, Narumi Jinguji walked past carrying a chart.

speaker: Narrator
text: The moment Mika saw Narumi's face and name badge, her gaze paused almost imperceptibly. She quickly looked away and lowered her head to straighten the folder in her hands.

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi did not break stride. With an unchanged expression, she turned into the surgical nurses' station.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren Nanase was checking the afternoon supply sheet. Seeing Narumi enter, she looked up softly.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “Dr. Jinguji?”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “Has the saleswoman who just registered at reception ever done business with our hospital?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren glanced at the internal routing form:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “No. The register says this is her first visit. She used Dr. Sakaguchi's arrival and the expansion of surgery as an opportunity to bring a catalogue of new gynecologic and pelvic surgical instruments.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi's fingers paused lightly at the edge of the chart.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “Her first visit… Yet when we passed in the corridor, her first reaction to seeing me wasn't how someone looks at a complete stranger.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren's expression sharpened slightly:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “…Could she simply have recognized your name?”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “Perhaps I'm overthinking it. One look alone proves nothing.”

speaker: Narrator
text: She closed the chart, her voice calm and cautious.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “But to be safe, don't alert Dr. Sakaguchi yet. OR Three has no cases this afternoon, and its equipment was just inspected. When you collect her from reception, don't introduce yourself. Tell her you're taking her to

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: verify tray specifications in the surgical area, then bring her straight to the pre-op room beside OR Three.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren looked at Narumi and immediately understood her intent.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “Understood. I'll put away my name badge and bring her over now.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika spread her branded product catalogue across the table one page at a time, explaining it in a crisp, efficient cadence.

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “These pelvic retractors and atraumatic dissectors use an improved curvature that maintains excellent exposure in a narrow, deep field. The jaws are specially blunted to minimize compression injury to the ovarian

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: cortex and surrounding vessels.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi calmly studied the specification page:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “You know the specifications and indications by heart. You clearly are an experienced specialist in gynecologic surgical instruments, Ms. Shimotsuki.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika smiled with a trace of pride:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “I handle priority departments at several major hospitals. Without knowing the business, I would never get through a chief surgeon's door.”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “But the catalogue doesn't appear to include long-term clinical follow-up data for this set.”

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “That data is still being compiled. I can have the company send it to your purchasing email later.”

speaker: Narrator
text: As she put away the presentation charts, she changed the subject with studied casualness:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “While researching before my visit, Dr. Jinguji's name seemed familiar. Before Hoshimi, did you work at another very large general hospital?”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “My medical résumé has always been public. It is no secret.”

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “That hospital's research platform is famous in the field. Why did you suddenly leave it for a small hospital like this?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi did not answer immediately. She simply watched Mika steer the conversation toward personnel changes.

speaker: Narrator
text: Still arranging her folder, Mika added as if it meant nothing:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “I also heard a young nurse left that hospital at about the same time. Nurse Nanase, who brought me here from reception, moved so confidently. She must be an old partner who followed you here then, correct?”

speaker: Narrator
text: A knock sounded at that exact moment.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren entered carrying a tray and casually pulled shut the door from the preparation room to the outer corridor.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “Excuse me. Dr. Jinguji, your tea.”

speaker: Narrator
text: She set down the cup but did not turn to leave. Instead she remained by the door, her calm gaze fixed on Mika's face.

speaker: Narrator
text: Having heard the final sentence outside, Ren understood everything. When collecting Mika, she had deliberately worn an unbadged work coat, never spoken her name, and discussed nothing beyond instrument specifications.

speaker: Narrator
text: Yet this woman had called her “Nurse Nanase” and even knew that she and Narumi came from the same former hospital.

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi lifted the teacup without drinking and spoke in an even tone:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “Perfect timing, Nurse Nanase. Ms. Shimotsuki was just taking an interest in our former careers.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika laughed:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “Just a salesperson's professional habit. I was making conversation.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren remained by the door. Her voice was gentle, but every word was clear:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “If this were a salesperson's professional habit, on the way from the first floor to surgery you would have asked about our tray dimensions and sterilization procedures. But since entering, you have watched the duty

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: roster on the corridor wall, not the instrument cabinets.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika's smile stiffened slightly:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “That…”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi set down her cup and looked directly into Mika's eyes:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “I have a question as well, Ms. Shimotsuki. Reception never introduced the nursing staff. When Nurse Nanase collected you, she wore no badge and never gave her name. How did you know her surname was Nanase without

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: any introduction?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika's eyes flickered, and she forced a smile:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “I… asked colleagues about your staffing before I came…”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “Hoshimi publishes only attending physicians' profiles. Nursing schedules and employment histories are never public. Even our own colleagues rarely know she once worked at the same hospital as I did.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi reached out and closed the elegant catalogue on the table, taking in the familiar custom exhibition brooch at Mika's collar as well.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “That concludes the instrument presentation. Now let us discuss something outside the catalogue.”

speaker: Narrator
text: The air in the preparation room abruptly turned cold.

speaker: Narrator
text: Caught in her mistake, Mika snatched up her briefcase and sprang to her feet.

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “If Dr. Jinguji isn't interested in our products, there must be some misunderstanding. I won't take any more of your time. Goodbye.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren stood quietly before the door without yielding a step.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “Ms. Shimotsuki, please answer Dr. Jinguji first.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika's face went ashen:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “What are you doing? You have no right to detain me!”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “You're right. So tell us honestly who sent you with a list to confirm that the two of us were at Hoshimi, and I will stop wasting your time.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika clenched her teeth:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “No one! I only—”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “Ryuji Hirasaka?”

speaker: Narrator
text: The five syllables fell into the silent room, almost soundless.

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika's pupils contracted violently. Her forced composure shattered, and even the fingers holding her briefcase trembled.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren slowly lowered her eyes by the door.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “It appears I was right.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika shouted sharply:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “Move! Don't think hiding in a place like this means you can pretend nothing happened—!”

speaker: Narrator
text: She spun toward the door and lunged for the handle.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “Ms. Shimotsuki, wait—”

speaker: Narrator
text: A brief struggle cut her off.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren swiftly turned and caught Mika's wrist. At the same instant, Narumi produced a prepared syringe and decisively injected her upper arm.

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika's eyes widened in terror. Pain flashed through her arm; she tried to scream, but her voice rapidly lost its strength.

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “You… would dare, inside a hospital…”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi caught her as she slid down the door.

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “Let… go…”

speaker: Narrator
text: Before she could finish the last word, she lost consciousness completely.

speaker: Narrator
text: The room fell silent.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren looked down at Mika, then raised her eyes to Narumi.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “Dr. Jinguji, are we really going through with this?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi looked at her, voice calm and controlled.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “If we stop now, Hirasaka will send a third person tomorrow. Only if she becomes too frightened to involve herself again can we buy time.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren slowly nodded.

speaker: Narrator
text: Her customary gentle smile had vanished entirely.

speaker: Narrator
text: When Mika awoke, the first thing she saw was the preparation room's stark white ceiling.

speaker: Narrator
text: She lay on a transport bed. Her jacket, skirt, and heels were gone; she now wore a thin patient gown, and a pre-op cap completely contained her hair.

speaker: Narrator
text: ECG and blood-pressure monitors were connected beside her wrist.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren stood beside the bed in green scrubs, checking the instrument readings.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “You're awake.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika tried to sit up with a violent struggle, but the restraint at the side of the bed held her down.

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “What are you trying to do?! Let me go! I'm calling the police!”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi approached holding a folder.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “Look at this first.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Printed clearly at the top of the page were the words:

speaker: Narrator
text: Consent for Diagnostic Exploratory Laparotomy

speaker: Narrator
text: The patient-name field read “Mika Shimotsuki.”

speaker: Narrator
text: The signature field also bore a signature almost identical to her own handwriting.

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika's face turned deathly pale:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “I didn't sign this!”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “I know.”

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “It's forged! This is a crime!”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “Of course it is forged.”

speaker: Narrator
text: She admitted it so calmly that Mika momentarily forgot what insult should come next.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “I will ask again. What did Ryuji Hirasaka send you here to do?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika bit down hard on her lip:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “I don't know anything!”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi gently closed the folder.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “Then we will have to talk somewhere else.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika's voice trembled:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “…Where?”

speaker: Narrator
text: At the far end of the inner passage, the doors to OR Three slowly opened.

speaker: Narrator
text: The transport bed stopped beside the operating table in OR Three.

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi and Ren were the only other people in the room.

speaker: Narrator
text: Under the glaring surgical lights, Mika saw the narrow operating table and finally understood that the earlier consent form was more than a simple threat.

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “No… no! I'm not sick! I don't need any operation!”

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren stood by the table wearing only green scrubs, cap, and surgical mask. Her voice remained soft, but offered no reassurance.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “I heard you.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi and Ren moved Mika onto the operating table and fastened the restraints around both wrists and legs. Mika stared in terror at the neatly arranged metal instruments and heard the faint sounds of cloth, metal,

speaker: Narrator
text: and packaging as Ren opened the preparation set.

speaker: Narrator
text: Again and again, Mika cried that she had never signed the consent form.

speaker: Narrator
text: Yet Ren's preoperative preparations did not stop.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren silently and expertly completed abdominal hair preparation, urinary catheterization, and povidone-iodine antisepsis in sequence. Once the green sterile fenestrated drapes covered and secured her entire body, only

speaker: Narrator
text: the planned abdominal field remained exposed beneath the surgical lights.

speaker: Narrator
text: In real surgery, each step served a medical purpose. Here, they were being used to create a hopeless illusion.

speaker: Narrator
text: Tears slid beneath the edge of Mika's cap as she cried out to Ren beside the table:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “Please… don't cut me! I told you I'm not a patient! Nurse Nanase, you don't look like this kind of person… Make her stop!”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi had changed into a complete sterile gown and gloves and now walked slowly to the surgeon's position.

speaker: Narrator
text: A surgical mask covered the lower half of her face. Her exposed eyes were almost emotionlessly calm.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “You are not a patient. I know that better than anyone.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika trembled uncontrollably:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “Then why…?!”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “Because from the moment you entered, you treated this place as someone else's territory.”

speaker: Narrator
text: She extended a hand toward Ren across the table.

speaker: Narrator
text: A scalpel was placed in her sterile-gloved palm.

speaker: Narrator
text: The metal made no unusual sound, yet the immobilized Mika seemed to hear something terrifying.

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi did not raise the blade. Instead she gently rested the cold back of the scalpel against the still-unbroken skin of the abdominal field.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “One last time. Who sent you?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika broke completely, a scream bursting from her throat:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “Hirasaka! Dr. Hirasaka! It was all his idea!”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi's hand remained perfectly still.

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika shouted through tears and mucus:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “He heard you might be at Hoshimi and told me to confirm it while delivering an instrument catalogue! He wants your current names, jobs, addresses, and exactly how much you've told Director Jogu about the past!”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “Why did he choose you?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika sobbed between ragged breaths:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “Because I sell gynecologic instruments for him! He controls all my contracts with the major hospitals. I owe him favors, and I had a private relationship with him… I took his money, but he also warned that if I

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: refused this errand, he would have every partner hospital blacklist me!”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “So you came.”

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “Yes! I thought I only had to confirm who was here and ask a few questions! I never meant to hurt you!”

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren remained by the instrument table, one hand resting lightly over the breast pocket of her scrubs. The miniature recorder concealed inside was running.

speaker: Narrator
text: Haltingly, Mika disclosed the contact method, payment, and agreed reporting deadline. She spoke so quickly that several times she had to stop and gasp for breath.

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi neither lifted nor withdrew the scalpel, as though waiting for a report to reach its final page.

speaker: Narrator
text: At last, Ren raised her head.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “Dr. Jinguji. She has told us everything.”

speaker: Narrator
text: The operating room fell silent.

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi looked at Ren, then drew back her hand and returned the scalpel to the instrument table.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “It's over.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika stared at her blankly:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “…Over?”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “No one is going to cut you.”

speaker: Narrator
text: For a moment, Mika could not speak.

speaker: Narrator
text: After a long while, she finally asked in a trembling, tearful voice:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “From the beginning… this was an act?”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “I never intended to make an incision.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika broke down and screamed:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “How could I possibly know that while I was lying on the table?!”

speaker: Narrator
text: This time Narumi gave no answer. She and Ren simply began releasing the restraints and removing the drapes and catheter.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Sakaguchi had come to the supply room at the end of the surgical wing to verify an inventory record for surgical sutures.

speaker: Narrator
text: Passing the inner corridor outside OR Three, he saw its indicator light illuminated despite no case being scheduled there that afternoon.

speaker: Narrator
text: Through the heavy door, he faintly heard a man's name from within.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ryuji Hirasaka.

speaker: Narrator
text: Sakaguchi stopped. He had recently seen that name on the title page of an old paper in Narumi's office.

speaker: Narrator
text: Then came a woman's uncontrolled sobbing.

speaker: Narrator
text: Frowning, Sakaguchi approached the blind angle beside the observation window and looked inside. The operating table was draped. Narumi, in a sterile gown, returned an unstained scalpel to the instrument table and said

speaker: Narrator
text: coldly, “No one is going to cut you… I never intended to make an incision.” Beside her, Ren wore only green scrubs and moved to remove the woman's drapes.

speaker: Narrator
text: Sakaguchi slowly released his hand from beside the door handle.

speaker: Narrator
text: The scene clearly exceeded the bounds of normal medical practice. Yet after seeing Narumi put down the scalpel and hearing her explicitly say she would not cut, Sakaguchi did not storm inside to condemn them. He knew

speaker: Narrator
text: something extraordinarily difficult must have driven the normally rule-bound Narumi and Ren to such misconduct inside the hospital.

speaker: Narrator
text: Footsteps sounded from the other end of the corridor. A duty nurse approached carrying a tray and looked curiously toward the lit OR Three:

speaker: Duty Nurse
text: “Dr. Sakaguchi? Is there an emergency operation in OR Three this evening?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Without showing any reaction, Sakaguchi shifted to block the door and spoke calmly:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: “There is no operation. I asked Dr. Jinguji and Nurse Nanase to help check the placement of several instruments. They turned on the light and are nearly finished cleaning up.”

speaker: Narrator
text: The duty nurse nodded:

speaker: Duty Nurse
text: “I see. Then I'll get back to work up front.”

speaker: Narrator
text: After sending her away, Sakaguchi took one final look at the two women cleaning the instruments. Without interrupting, he quietly turned and left the corridor.

speaker: Narrator
text: Inside, Ren had just removed her mask. Through the observation window she caught sight of the departing white coat and froze slightly:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “Dr. Jinguji… I think that was Dr. Sakaguchi outside.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi looked at the empty corridor beyond the window, her expression sharpening:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “…First take her to observation. Once we finish dealing with today's situation, we will confess everything to the director.”

speaker: Narrator
text: In the private observation room, Mika had changed back into her own clothes.

speaker: Narrator
text: A regular outpatient nurse who had not participated in the afternoon's events had followed standard procedure to measure her blood pressure and heart rate. Only after confirming stable vital signs and no obvious acute

speaker: Narrator
text: abnormality did the nurse leave.

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi and Ren now stood at the doorway without approaching her again.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “I will keep the recording secure. I won't give it to Hirasaka.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika looked up, her face darkening further:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “…You recorded me?”

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “Yes.”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “The forged consent form has been destroyed. You may call the police or complain to the director about what happened today. We will not deny it.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika gripped her phone until her knuckles turned white:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “And then what? You hand over the recording of my confession?”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “We cannot decide the consequences for you.”

speaker: Narrator
text: The phone in Mika's bag vibrated. A message appeared, demanding a progress report.

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika stared at the screen, her voice rough:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “What am I supposed to say when he asks whether I found you? If I say yes, he'll ask why I stayed in the hospital so long. If I tell him about the operating room, he'll only suspect that I've confessed everything

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: about him.”

speaker: Narrator
text: She slowly raised her head and looked at the two women by the door:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “You know better than I do what he does to people who betray him, don't you?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi's eyes hardened:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “We know.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika typed rapidly, revised the message several times, and finally pressed send: “Made contact with Hoshimi Hospital as agreed. Found no evidence that either target works here. Recommend no further manpower.”

speaker: Narrator
text: She held up the successful-send screen for Narumi to see and spoke coldly:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “I told him you aren't here. Not because I trust you. I just… don't want to destroy myself.”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “I won't ask you to thank us.”

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “Make sure you don't.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren placed Mika's briefcase beside the table:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “A car is waiting at the hospital entrance. The driver only knows he is collecting a departing visitor. Whether you take it is your choice.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika picked up the bag and reached the door, then abruptly stopped:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “What are you people?”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “A doctor and a nurse at Hoshimi Hospital.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Mika stared at her for a long time, then gave a cold laugh:

speaker: Mika Shimotsuki
text: “…Today, I don't want to believe that at all.”

speaker: Narrator
text: With that, she left the hospital without looking back.

speaker: Narrator
text: After seeing Mika off, Narumi and Ren did not return to the lounge. They went directly to knock on the director's office door.

speaker: Narrator
text: The recorder lay on the desk beside the written incident reports they had prepared voluntarily.

speaker: Narrator
text: After hearing the account and confirming that an independent clinician had verified Mika's stable vital signs before departure, Asuka Jogu exhaled softly and regarded them both with a grave expression.

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: “Neither of you concealed this from me. You came here to confess immediately after seeing her off. I will remember that.”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “Using the spare operating room to frighten a visitor was my decision. I will accept every internal penalty. Please do not implicate the hospital or Ren.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren hurried to speak:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “Director, I chose to help Dr. Jinguji. If there is punishment, include me too.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka shook her head. Her tone was not harsh, but the boundary she set was unmistakable:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: “I took you into Hoshimi despite the pressure because I wanted you to escape that old environment and practice openly as a doctor and nurse. Even if neither of you ever intended to cut her, using this hospital's

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: operating room as an instrument of intimidation crossed an absolute line. I will seal this record in our internal file, but nothing like it may ever happen again in a Hoshimi operating room. Understood?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi bowed her head solemnly:

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “I understand, Director. There will never be a second time.”

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “I'm sorry, Director…”

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka's expression softened, and one finger lightly touched the final paragraph of their statement:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: “But you said Dr. Sakaguchi passed OR Three this evening, heard the disturbance, and deliberately sent away a duty nurse who approached?”

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “Yes. He didn't come inside to accuse us, but he must have heard Hirasaka's name.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren said quietly:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “And when Mika Shimotsuki registered this afternoon, she used Dr. Sakaguchi's recent arrival as her excuse. If Hirasaka doesn't fully believe her false report and sends someone else to test us, they may target Dr.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: Sakaguchi next…”

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka considered this, then looked up to ask their opinion:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: “Dr. Sakaguchi covered for you at the door, and he is now your most frequent surgical partner. Keeping him in the dark only leaves him vulnerable. Tomorrow morning I will speak with him for ten minutes. Without

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: revealing private details about your former hospital, I will warn him that Hirasaka sent someone to investigate. Do you agree?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi and Ren exchanged a look and nodded together.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “If it is Dr. Sakaguchi, I agree.”

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “Yes. I agree too.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Early the next morning, Ryuji Sakaguchi came to the director's office as requested.

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka pushed a cup of warm tea toward him:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: “Good morning, Dr. Sakaguchi. I called you before clinic begins. This will take only ten minutes.”

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: “Good morning, Director. This is about OR Three yesterday evening, isn't it?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka smiled faintly:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: “Nothing gets past you. After Narumi and Ren saw off that saleswoman, Mika Shimotsuki, they came straight to me last night to confess and accept punishment. They made a point of telling me that you helped by sending

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: away the nurse outside.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Sakaguchi lifted the teacup:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: “I saw they were already finishing. There was no need for anyone else to stumble onto the scene.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka looked at him:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: “When you saw a doctor and nurse you trust clearly violating the rules in a spare operating room, did you never consider going straight inside to stop them?”

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: “In clinical work, they follow the rules more strictly than anyone. Rather than storm in to accuse them, I wanted to know what trouble had driven them that far.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka's expression tightened, and she shook her head seriously:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: “Still, Narumi did not lose her head in a panic yesterday. She knew exactly what she was doing and deliberately chose that method after careful consideration. I can understand their circumstances, but Hoshimi

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: Hospital can never become a tool she uses against old enemies.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka let the smile fade and earnestly explained the situation to Sakaguchi:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: “After obtaining Narumi and Ren's consent, I called you here today to formally bring you into the loop. Both of them once worked at a hospital under Ryuji Hirasaka's control, but later broke with him completely.

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: Narumi in particular has a very complicated history with Hirasaka. I think what happened should be for her to tell you herself. When they left and Hirasaka suppressed them throughout the medical field, I was the one

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: who brought them to Hoshimi.”

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: “So Mika Shimotsuki was an investigator Hirasaka sent to find them.”

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: “Yes. To protect herself, Mika sent Hirasaka a false report saying she found no evidence they worked here, but a man like him may not believe it easily. She also deliberately used your name at reception yesterday. If

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: Hirasaka tries a more discreet probe next, he may approach your surgical clinic directly.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Sakaguchi nodded:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: “Understood. If I notice anything unusual in clinic or among referrals, I will report it immediately.”

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: “There is one more thing. When they left this office last night, both were deeply uneasy. They feared that after seeing yesterday's scene, you would consider them dangerous and refuse to work with them again.”

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: “They have admitted their mistake to the director, so that page is finished. The next time trouble comes from outside, we will face it together.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka smiled with relief:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: “With those words, the weight on both their hearts can finally lift.”

speaker: Narrator
text: The wall clock completed exactly ten minutes and pointed to eight fifty.

speaker: Narrator
text: Asuka stood:

speaker: Asuka Jogu
text: “There. Exactly ten minutes. I needn't relay the message for you. Those two have probably been waiting in the corridor to read your expression this whole time.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Sakaguchi said goodbye, opened the office door, and stepped outside.

speaker: Narrator
text: In the sunlight at the corridor corner, Narumi and Ren had indeed stopped on their way to the clinic and ward.

speaker: Narrator
text: At the sound of the door, they turned together. The normally composed Narumi's fingers tightened slightly, while Ren watched him with open unease.

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “D-Dr. Sakaguchi… Is the director finished talking to you?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Sakaguchi looked at their tense expressions and lifted his clipboard as naturally as he did before daily rounds.

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: “We're finished. Clinic begins in ten minutes. Dr. Jinguji, have you checked the pre-op assessment for this afternoon's operation?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Narumi froze for a moment. The guarded tension in her eyes quietly melted away, and her usual warm, intelligent smile returned to her lips.

speaker: Narumi Jinguji
text: “It is checked. We can operate at any time.”

speaker: Narrator
text: Sakaguchi turned to Ren:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: “Nurse Nanase, what about this morning's ward handoff?”

speaker: Narrator
text: Ren's eyes lit up. She nodded vigorously, smiling brightly:

speaker: Ren Nanase
text: “Everything is confirmed! We can start whenever you're ready, Dr. Sakaguchi!”

speaker: Narrator
text: Sakaguchi nodded lightly:

speaker: Ryuji Sakaguchi
text: “Then let's go.”
